name: Web Culture Connector
changelog: 1.4.1 – Keeps itself up to date: WordPress installs new Connector versions automatically in the background, and EventureOS pushes the newest version to any site still behind. 1.4.0 – Backups on the site's own server before every change (database, code or full; sliced so shared hosting doesn't time out; newest 5 kept; one-time download links; database restore) and content tools for AI-assisted maintenance: pages and posts, Elementor layouts, SEO titles/descriptions, images, menus and site settings — every change logged and undoable. 1.3.0 – Remote theme/plugin deployment: the command centre can install or overwrite a theme or plugin from a sent package and activate it (POST /deploy). 1.2.1 – No more “new version available” for the version you already have; tells the command centre its version on sign-in. 1.2.0 – One-click support sign-in from the command centre (single-use 60-second links, logged; can be switched off in Tools → Web Culture). 1.1.1 – Neutral plugin description. 1.1.0 – Hosting administration (lock/unlock from EventureOS, pay page for visitors); self-updates from EventureOS. 1.0.0 – Status, updates, cache purge, maintenance log.
